title: Late-Payment Fee Carried by the Opening Charge of a Pro Upgrade Term
content:
The late-payment fee taken off the credit basis of a Professional Email Pro upgrade is the late-payment fee the opening renewal charge carried, read from the calendar days from the term start date to the charge date of the opening renewal charge (the renewal charge whose period start is the term start date).

| Days from the term start date to the charge date of the opening renewal charge | Late-payment fee taken off |
|---|---|
| 15 days or more | 15.00 |
| from 4 up to 14 days | 10.00 |
| from 1 up to 3 days | 5.00 |
| a charge billed on or before its period start, or no renewal charge on record | none |

Edges: 3 days, 5.00; 4 days, 10.00; 14 days, 10.00; 15 days, 15.00.

Example (hypothetical): a renewal charge whose period starts on 1 March and whose charge date is 6 March was billed 5 days after its period start, so 10.00 is taken off the credit basis.
